Yes! They set the opponent on fire! Just as it should be! Yes! Correct! You needed this victory so badly! It was hard to say in advance who would win! Well done! Congratulations! Thank you very much! Last KNB! KNB! One point for this round and five points in total! The Hansons managed to come second! They have seven points in total!

And the absolute conquerors of New York are the Illuminators team! Their three points for this race bring them a total of six! The final round of the competition! Kick the aliens! It will take place here! A fierce battle! Each operator must reach this point and cut three wires, which will allow them to pass through the force field! Only after overcoming the obstacles can they shoot at the alien leader! The first one to hit this evil mother-yammer right in the eye gets three points! Who will lead this time? Me! And the same number of shots and everything else? Yes, we've reloaded again! We calculated that if I don't hit within 60-70 shots, I'll have to turn the gun on myself!

So far, guys, you're in first place! What does it feel like? An amazing feeling! Do you think you'll hold onto the lead? We will! John will do his job! He hates aliens! I'll crush them! Now for the next part! I'll explain the scenario! Luke Skywalker in his jet fighter! He has to shoot downwards and destroy the enemy! No wizard can help! And you, Luke Skywalker, can you do it? Absolutely! He's doomed to win!
This is your round! You have to manage it! Good luck! Thank you! We'll try! Thank you, Rossi!
All teams are confident they have what it takes! But Judge Greg has his own opinion!

Essentially, it all comes down to this round! Yes! Anyone can win! All teams crave victory and are doing everything they can to achieve it! In my opinion, the Illuminators have some advantages! The final accurate shot will decide it! Yes! Their ability to cut wires is equal! Removing the control panels too! So it all depends on one accurate shot! If they miss, the Hansons won't hesitate! Correct! The conditions are equal, but I still favour the Illuminators! They've completed two very difficult challenges! Now for the final battle, but the most mind-blowing is yet to come!
Superhumans on the scrap heap! Cinema!

Superhumans on the scrap heap! Cinema! This is the Superhumans on the scrap heap programme again! And our Hollywood stars are ready for the final battle! The KNB currently have 5 points! Right in the eye! Excellent! Excellent! Excellent! Excellent! Thus ended the desperate struggle of good versus evil. The KNB drew first blood, winning the aesthetics competition. The Hansen snipers destroyed the aliens in the wild, wild west. The lighting crew, entering the fray, burned and ate the aliens in post-apocalyptic New York, and also destroyed the alien queen in the final battle, finally crushing the cosmic enemy. So, guys, first of all I want to thank the KNB, Jim Henson's Creature Shop and the Light and Magic group for their kindness in participating in the show 'Trash-O-Saurus'. Fantastic! Wonderful!
